# Verify contracts

- [Run cases](running.md): commands, hosts, fixture setup, evidence and the repository gate.
- [Laws](laws.md): lifecycle, evidence, host boundaries and the tests that detect a violation.
- [API](api.md): public calls and report semantics.
- [Execution](execution.md): plans, hosts, workers, gates and transport.
- [Experience verification](experience.md): shared cases, native actors, simulated networking and benchmarks.
- [Consumer diagnostics](lint.md): lint policy and portable specification checks.
- [Source rights](../PROVENANCE.md): original source, MIT grant and public distribution.

[AGENTS](../AGENTS.md) owns the contribution procedure. The [consumer skill](../.agents/skills/verify/SKILL.md) owns the adoption procedure.
A document describes a contract. Only a run produces evidence.
